name: Ezhance – Product Discounts, Bulk Pricing and Safety Score for WooCommerce
author: Sathyaseelan

sections.description:
Ezhance helps WooCommerce merchants create, display, control, and track product-level promotions from one dashboard.

WooCommerce store owners often need more than a basic coupon code. They need offers that shoppers can understand before checkout, rules that apply only to the right products, and better visibility into whether a promotion is safe to run.

With Ezhance, you can create simple product discounts, bulk pricing offers, product-page offer messages, strikeout pricing, scheduled promotions, usage-limited campaigns, and promotion analytics. Version 1.1.0 also adds Offer Safety Score, a merchant-friendly scoring panel that helps you review promotion risk before publishing.

For WooCommerce agencies, Ezhance provides a structured promotion workflow that can reduce custom WooCommerce discount snippets, scattered coupon setups, and one-off promotion logic across client stores.

With the separate Ezhance Pro add-on, you can unlock advanced promotion workflows such as Buy X Get X, Buy X Get Y, cart discounts, free shipping promotions, auto-added free gifts, cart progress bars, countdown timers, savings messages, order reward coupons, margin range targeting, stock level targeting, and advanced customer/cart/order conditions.

View Website | Simple Discount Demo | Bulk Pricing Demo | Buy X Get Y Demo | Buy X Get X Demo

Key Free Features

  • Create simple product discounts — apply fixed or percentage discounts to selected products.
  • Create fixed amount product discounts — for example, give $5 off a product.
  • Create percentage product discounts — for example, give 10% off selected products.
  • Create bulk pricing and tiered quantity discounts — encourage shoppers to buy more.
  • Target specific WooCommerce products and variations.
  • Add cart subtotal conditions.
  • Add cart item count conditions.
  • Show product-page offer cards.
  • Show bulk pricing tables on product pages.
  • Show optional strikeout pricing.
  • Refresh product pricing when quantity changes.
  • Schedule promotions for campaign periods.
  • Set promotion usage limits.
  • Track promotion usage from WooCommerce orders.
  • View a Margin (%) column in the WooCommerce product list.
  • Use Offer Safety Score to review promotion risk before publishing.
  • Recalculate promotion scores in bulk.

Offer Safety Score

Discounts can increase sales, but they can also reduce profit when the offer is too aggressive, applies to low-margin products, stacks with other discounts, or is unclear to shoppers.

The Ezhance Offer Safety Score helps merchants review a promotion before it goes live.

The score uses a 0-100 rating across key areas such as:

  • Margin safety.
  • Discount depth.
  • Purchase threshold quality.
  • Stacking risk.
  • Abuse control.
  • Offer clarity.
  • Data confidence.

For fixed-amount discounts, Ezhance can also highlight the worst-case eligible product so merchants can see which product is most affected by the discount.

Example:

  • A $5 fixed discount may be safe on a $100 product.
  • The same $5 discount may be risky on a $10 product.
  • Ezhance helps show that difference before the promotion is published.

The Safety Score is designed as a decision-support tool. It helps merchants understand potential commercial risk, but it is not a guarantee of profit or financial advice.

Product Margin Column

Ezhance adds a Margin (%) column to the WooCommerce product list.

This helps merchants quickly review product margin levels while planning offers. Margin values can also support safer promotion decisions inside the Offer Safety Score.

Example use cases:

  • Identify products with thin margins before discounting.
  • Review whether a product can safely support a promotion.
  • Spot high-margin products that may be better candidates for campaign offers.
  • Improve fixed-discount decisions across products with different prices.

Product Discount Examples

Product discounts help WooCommerce merchants run product-level campaigns without manually editing product prices.

Use Ezhance product discounts for:

  • Seasonal sales.
  • Product launch offers.
  • Clearance campaigns.
  • Selected product promotions.
  • Limited-time product deals.
  • Product or variation-specific campaigns.

Example scenarios:

  • Give 10% off a selected bag.
  • Give $5 off a specific accessory.
  • Discount selected products for a holiday campaign.
  • Apply a promotion only when cart subtotal is above a chosen amount.
  • Schedule a product discount to run during a weekend sale.

View example: Simple Discount Demo

Bulk Discount, Quantity Discount and Tiered Pricing Examples

Bulk pricing, also known as quantity discount or tiered pricing, helps merchants encourage shoppers to buy more of the same product.

As shoppers increase quantity, they can receive a better price or a larger discount. This is useful for stores selling accessories, consumables, supplies, wholesale products, bundles, and repeat-purchase items.

Example scenarios:

  • Buy 2 or more and save 5%.
  • Buy 5 or more and save 10%.
  • Buy 10 or more and get a better unit price.
  • Create wholesale-style quantity pricing.
  • Show a buy-more-save-more table on the product page.
  • Encourage customers to increase quantity before checkout.

View example: Bulk Purchase Offer on Analog Watches

Product-Page Offer Messages

Discounts are easier to understand when shoppers can see the offer before checkout.

Ezhance lets merchants show product-page offer cards for eligible promotions. These messages help shoppers understand the active deal while they are viewing the product.

Use offer cards to explain:

  • What the promotion is.
  • Which product is eligible.
  • Which quantity is required.
  • Which cart condition must be met.
  • How the shopper can receive the discount.
  • When the promotion is available.

Example scenarios:

  • Show “Buy more and save more” above the add-to-cart button.
  • Explain a product discount on the product page.
  • Highlight a limited-time product offer.
  • Tell shoppers how many units are required to unlock a better price.

Strikeout Pricing

Ezhance includes optional strikeout pricing so shoppers can compare the regular product price with the promotional price.

Strikeout pricing can help stores make discounts easier to understand across product, catalog, and cart surfaces.

Example scenarios:

  • Show the regular price crossed out next to the discounted price.
  • Make product savings visible before checkout.
  • Help shoppers quickly compare original and promotional prices.

Promotion Targeting and Conditions

A good promotion should apply only where it makes sense.

Ezhance gives merchants control over which products qualify and when the promotion should apply.

Free targeting and condition options include:

  • Specific product targeting.
  • Product variation targeting.
  • Cart subtotal condition.
  • Cart item count condition.
  • Promotion schedule.
  • Usage limits.
  • Promotion priority.

Example scenarios:

  • Apply a discount only to selected products.
  • Apply a promotion only when the cart subtotal is above $100.
  • Apply a promotion only when the cart has 3 or more items.
  • Schedule a promotion for a specific campaign period.
  • Limit how many times a promotion can be used.

Promotion Analytics

Ezhance records promotion usage from WooCommerce orders so merchants can review campaign performance.

Promotion analytics help store owners understand:

  • Which promotions were used.
  • Which products received promotion discounts.
  • Which orders included promotion activity.
  • How much discount was applied.
  • How often a promotion was used.

This helps merchants move beyond guesswork and review real promotion usage from order data.

Ezhance Pro Features

Ezhance Pro is a separate add-on. It is not required to use the free product discount, bulk pricing, product-page offer display, Offer Safety Score, and promotion analytics features.

Pro adds advanced promotion workflows such as:

  • Buy X Get X offers.
  • Buy X Get Y offers.
  • Cart discounts.
  • Free shipping promotions.
  • Auto-added free gifts.
  • Cart progress bars.
  • Countdown timers.
  • Savings messages.
  • Order reward coupons.
  • My Account coupon pages.
  • Category targeting.
  • Tag targeting.
  • Attribute targeting.
  • Sale item exclusion.
  • Margin range targeting.
  • Stock level targeting.
  • Customer conditions.
  • Advanced cart conditions.
  • Order conditions.
  • Address conditions.
  • Shop time conditions.

Pro example scenarios:

  • Buy one hoodie and get another hoodie free or discounted.
  • Buy one product and get a different product free or discounted.
  • Spend $100 and get 10% off the cart.
  • Show shoppers how much more they need to spend to unlock free shipping.
  • Apply offers only to products within a chosen gross margin range.
  • Apply offers only to products with stock below, above, or between selected thresholds.
  • Give customers a future coupon after completing an order.

Why Merchants Use Ezhance

WooCommerce merchants often need a promotion system that helps them create offers, show those offers clearly, control eligibility, and review campaign usage.

Ezhance helps solve common merchant problems such as:

  • Managing product discounts without manually changing product prices.
  • Creating quantity-based offers without confusing shoppers.
  • Showing promotions before checkout.
  • Avoiding scattered promotion rules across products, coupons, and custom snippets.
  • Reviewing promotion risk before publishing.
  • Running scheduled campaigns with better control.
  • Tracking promotion usage after orders are placed.

Why Agencies Use Ezhance

WooCommerce agencies often build stores where clients need to manage promotions after launch.

Ezhance gives agencies a structured promotion system that can be handed over to store owners.

Agencies can use Ezhance to:

  • Set up product-level promotion workflows for clients.
  • Reduce one-off custom discount snippets.
  • Provide repeatable promotion setup across WooCommerce projects.
  • Give clients a clearer way to manage product offers.
  • Support stores that need simple discounts, quantity offers, and promotion display.
  • Upgrade clients to advanced Pro promotion strategies when needed.

Live Demo Examples

Free promotion examples:

  • Simple Discount Demo
  • Bulk Purchase Offer on Analog Watches

Pro promotion examples:

  • Buy X Get Y Demo
  • Buy X Get X Demo

Some demo examples may require Ezhance Pro features.

Quick Links

  • Ezhance Website
  • Simple Discount Demo
  • Bulk Pricing Demo
  • Buy X Get Y Demo
  • Buy X Get X Demo

External Services

Ezhance stores promotion settings and promotion analytics in your WordPress site database.

The free plugin does not require an external service to calculate product discounts, display product-level offers, calculate Offer Safety Score, or track promotion usage.

The plugin may include links to Ezhance documentation, demos, support, pricing, or review pages. These links are opened only when a site administrator chooses to visit them.

If you use Ezhance Pro, license handling, billing, or premium update functionality may be handled by the Pro add-on and its licensing provider. Review the Pro plugin information and privacy policy before enabling Pro features.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress admin

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Ezhance”.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  5. Go to Ezhance in the WordPress admin menu.
  6. Create your first promotion.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Ezhance in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Create a promotion.
  6. Choose the promotion action, products, conditions, display settings, schedule, and limits.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or greater.
  • WooCommerce installed and active.
  • PHP 7.4 or greater.
sections.faq:
Does Ezhance require WooCommerce?

Yes. Ezhance is built for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

What problem does Ezhance solve?

Ezhance helps merchants create, display, control, and track WooCommerce promotions from one dashboard.

Instead of managing promotions through manual price changes, scattered coupon rules, custom snippets, and unclear offer messaging, Ezhance gives store owners a structured way to create product discounts, show offers to shoppers, review promotion risk, and track promotion usage from orders.

What types of promotions can I create in the free version?

The free version supports simple product discounts and bulk or tiered product discounts.

You can target specific products and variations, add basic cart conditions, show product-page offer cards, display bulk pricing tables, schedule promotions, set usage limits, review Offer Safety Score, and track promotion usage from WooCommerce orders.

What is Offer Safety Score?

Offer Safety Score is a 0-100 score that helps merchants review the commercial risk of a promotion before publishing.

It considers areas such as margin safety, discount depth, purchase thresholds, stacking risk, abuse control, offer clarity, and data confidence.

Is Offer Safety Score a profit guarantee?

No. Offer Safety Score is a decision-support tool. It helps merchants understand potential promotion risk, but it does not guarantee profit, revenue, conversion rate, or campaign performance.

Merchants should still consider product cost, shipping cost, payment fees, taxes, advertising cost, refunds, and their own business goals before running a promotion.

Does Ezhance send margin or promotion data to an external server for Safety Score?

The free plugin calculates product discounts and Offer Safety Score inside your WordPress site. The free plugin does not require an external service for Safety Score calculation.

Can I create bulk pricing offers?

Yes. Ezhance supports bulk and tiered product discounts in the free version.

You can create quantity tiers and show a bulk pricing table on the product page so shoppers can understand the available offer before adding the product to cart.

Can I show promotion messages on product pages?

Yes. Ezhance can show product-page offer cards and bulk pricing tables based on your promotion display settings.

Does Ezhance support strikeout pricing?

Yes. Ezhance includes optional strikeout pricing so shoppers can compare the regular product price with the discounted price.

Can I target specific products?

Yes. The free version supports specific product and variation targeting.

Can I schedule promotions?

Yes. Ezhance includes promotion scheduling so you can control when a promotion starts and ends.

Can I limit promotion usage?

Yes. Ezhance includes usage limits so you can control how often a promotion can be used.

Does Ezhance track promotion usage?

Yes. Ezhance records promotion usage from WooCommerce orders so merchants can review how promotions are used.

Does the free version include BOGO offers?

No. Buy X Get X, Buy X Get Y, auto-added free gifts, and other BOGO-style promotions are part of the separate Ezhance Pro add-on.

Does the free version include cart discounts or free shipping offers?

No. Cart discounts, free shipping promotions, and cart progress bars are part of Ezhance Pro.

Does Ezhance create normal WooCommerce coupons?

The free version focuses on product-level promotions, offer display, Offer Safety Score, and promotion analytics.

Ezhance Pro includes additional coupon-style promotion workflows such as cart discounts and order reward coupons.

Will Ezhance work with variable products?

Ezhance includes product and variation targeting.

As with any pricing plugin, test your promotion setup with your theme, payment plugins, tax settings, shipping settings, and other pricing-related plugins before using it on a live campaign.

Can agencies use Ezhance on client sites?

Yes. Ezhance is designed for both store owners and agencies.

It provides a structured promotion system that can reduce the need for custom WooCommerce discount work on client stores.

Where can I see examples?

You can view free promotion examples here:

  • Simple Discount Demo
  • Bulk Purchase Offer Demo

Pro examples are also available on the demo store:

  • Buy X Get Y Demo
  • Buy X Get X Demo
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added Margin (%) column to the WooCommerce product list table. Each product now shows its gross margin with a color-coded tier badge (Excellent, Healthy, Moderate, Thin), and the column is sortable.
  • Added Offer Safety Score, a 0-100 score calculated for each promotion to help merchants review commercial risk before publishing. The score is shown as a badge in the promotions list and as a detailed panel in the promotion editor.
  • Added batch score recalculation. A Recalculate Scores button in the promotions list reprocesses all promotion scores in the background with live progress feedback.
  • Added worst-case product analysis for promotions with a fixed-amount discount. The Safety Score panel shows which product is most at risk and why.
  • Pro: Added Stock Level targeting. Apply offers to products based on current WooCommerce stock quantity using below, above, or between thresholds. Only products with per-product stock management enabled are matched. The Offer Safety Score automatically flags low-stock targeting risks.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
  • Added simple product discount promotions.
  • Added bulk and tiered product discount promotions.
  • Added product and variation targeting.
  • Added cart subtotal and cart item count conditions.
  • Added product-page offer cards.
  • Added bulk pricing table display.
  • Added optional strikeout pricing.
  • Added product-page quantity price refresh.
  • Added promotion scheduling and usage limits.
  • Added promotion analytics from WooCommerce orders.
  • Added settings page for promotion display behavior.
